expectation: Membrane rings on small lymphocytes: naive and central-memory T cells, memory B cells, and bright plasma cells. Common in immune infiltrates, dense in lymphoid aggregates and stroma, and absent from tumour nests. Scattered single cells elsewhere.
observed: A: strong signal in stroma and immune-rich bands, with dark tumour nests spared. B, C: sparse scattered cells. D: a bright cell-sized membrane-like cluster. E: dense granular CD27 across an aggregate. CD20 cells are a subset, some white in the merge, with many CD27+ CD20− (T) cells.
why: CD27 marks a cellular lymphoid population confined to stroma and aggregates, sparing tumour nests, and partly overlaps CD20 as expected.
notes: CD27 lights immune-rich stroma and a lymphoid aggregate with granular, cell-sized signal and leaves tumour nests dark. Some CD20 B cells co-stain, and many CD27+ CD20− cells fit T cells. Some broad stromal glow, but the pattern is specific.
